limitations: Three dates belong to one biological animal, so cannot establish cross-subject generalization.
Exact electrode/contact coordinates do not establish longitudinal neuron identity.
ThresholdCrossings values are nonnegative integer counts described as crossings per 20ms, despite NWB ElectricalSeries unit volts; retain this source contradiction.
Native behavior is normalized flexion 0 fully extended to 1 fully flexed. No physical length inferred.
Actual clocks have jitter; timestamps preserved and no interpolation or synthetic completion used.
References establish sampled-bin availability only; no physiological or hardware completeness beyond those references is certified.
